Sanjay Raut claims jail food caused cancer, Rahul Gandhi suggested test

Shiv Sena (UBT) leader Sanjay Raut has claimed that his cancer may have been caused by the food served to him in jail. Raut also revealed that Congress leader Rahul Gandhi had suggested he undergo a toxicity test to check if poison was added to his food. Raut made these statements regarding his health and his time in jail.
